cases.name: Annalisa Lorraine Sandoval
cases.narrative: Gonzalez-Aguirre claimed said she stood next to a bed in front of him and made a comment saying she was “sick of things” before shooting herself. A detective noted that the crime scene did not align with his statement and no blood was visible where Sandoval reportedly shot herself. Deputies reportedly found Sandoval lying on a bathroom floor between a toilet and a wall, and it appeared she had been sitting. He reportedly admitted to shooting her through a wall while she was in the bathroom, and claimed the shooting was accidental.
